First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:45 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @dctriclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday No-Drop Group Bike Rides (DC Tri Club) group ride

Volunteer-led no-drop rides for people learning to ride in a group. Regroup points and a sweep on every ride. Start points move around the DMV and are posted a week ahead in the club's Sunday Bike Rides group. Routes repeat monthly so you can join any time.
